totalResults.description: Total number of archived user that match the query.

schemas.description: An array of schema URNs that define the structure of the SCIM resource.

Resources.description: A list of archived users matching the filter.

userName.description: The unique identifier for the user. This must be set to the user's primary email address. The `userName` value must be unique across Webex and is used for authentication.

emails.description: A list of the user's email addresses.

organization.description: The unique identifier for the organization.

id.description: The unique identifier for the user.

displayName.description: The display name of the user in Webex.

display.description: A human-readable description, primarily used for display purposes.

primary.description: Email status boolean value. If the type is work and primary is true, the value must equal `userName`.

created.description: The date and time the group was created.

lastModified.description: The date and time the group was last changed.

NameObject.description: The components of the user's real name.

givenName.description: The given name of the user, or first name in most Western languages (e.g., "Sarah" given the full name "Ms. Sarah J Henderson, III").

familyName.description: The family name of the user, or last name in most Western languages (e.g., "Henderson" given the full name "Ms. Sarah J Henderson, III").

middleName.description: The middle name(s) of the user (e.g., "Jane" given the full name "Ms. Sarah J Henderson, III").

honorificPrefix.description: The honorific prefix(es) of the user, or title in most Western languages (e.g., "Ms." given the full name "Ms. Sarah J Henderson, III").

honorificSuffix.description: The honorific suffix(es) of the user, or suffix in most Western languages (e.g., "III" given the full name "Ms. Sarah J Henderson, III").
